<b>Mawlings</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are the younger form of [[Marrowmaw]]s, capable of rolling themselves around surfaces.<ref>Mawling [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Young, bony bug that can curl its body to form a ball. Their rough, ridged shell grips tight to any surface. Even walls and roofs become pathways for these nimble bugs."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Mawlings are found standing on small platforms. When approached, they roll around the platform, clinging to the sides and bottom, and stop upon returning to their original position. They deal {{Damage|1}} upon contact.

As they are often present on very small platforms, it is usually best to attack them from an adjacent platform to avoid being hit by their attack.

Additionally, they take no knockback from any of [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]]'s attacks.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Mawlings have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== Location ==
Mawlings can first be found in the eastern section of [[Moss Grotto]], but they also appear in the western portion of [[Weavenest Atla]], as well as the lower section of the [[Memorium]].
